member.name: T:Durable.Sqlite.SqliteConnectionFactory
member.summary: Opens SQLite connections, relying on Microsoft.Data.Sqlite's built-in pooling. In-memory databases stay alive for the factory's lifetime: a private ":memory:" data source becomes a uniquely named in-memory database so every connection from this factory sees the same data, and one connection is kept open until the factory is disposed. It uses SQLite's "memdb" VFS (file:/name?vfs=memdb) rather than shared-cache mode: memdb uses normal database locking, so concurrent connections wait for each other (see ) instead of hitting shared-cache table locks, which Microsoft.Data.Sqlite surfaces as an . Other connection strings are used as given, so raw connections opened with the same string see the same database; to share a named in-memory database safely under concurrency, use Data Source=file:/name?vfs=memdb rather than Mode=Memory;Cache=Shared. Thread safety: safe for concurrent use.
